_about: Thinned excerpt of data/work/gns_index.json (NGA GNS Vietnam name index, WGS84) for the VHPA scope tests: the first place, admin, terrain, island or spot feature (fc P/A/T/L/S) in each 0.05-degree cell, rounded to 0.001 degree, all under one key. Names are dropped; vhpa.py only uses the positions.
